work_order.understanding: Four review findings from PR #59 on the /activity screen; all four still reproduce on main. (1) ActivityFeedSkeleton has no aria-busy and no sr-only role=status line, unlike GroupPageSkeleton, so the fallback is silent to a screen reader. (2) app/activity/page.tsx:140 passes `scoped?.id ?? rawGroupScope(rawGroup)` to ActivityFailed, so when the groups read succeeded but the feed read failed, a stranger's ?group= uuid still lands in the chip form's hidden input and the Retry href. (3) The 'Showing X only' line left <header className="flex flex-col gap-2"> and is now a child of <main ... gap-5>; in this repo's replaced spacing scale (globals.css --spacing-2=8px, -4=16px, -5=24px) it sits 24px under the title instead of 8px, and its fallback Skeleton h-6 (32px) is taller than the 20px text line. (4) is (2) seen from the comment/test side: the comment says the raw id is carried only when the groups read failed, the code carries it whenever the feed failed and the id is not a confirmed scope, and the wire test's third case is titled for the groups-read case while matching only the loose expression. (2) and (4) are one change. One screen, one component: no split.
work_order.root_cause: PR #59 moved the scope line and the failed branch into ActivityContent without tracking which read failed (one try block covers both awaits), so the failed branch falls back to the raw id regardless of whether the groups read could confirm it; and restructuring loading.tsx and the header dropped the loading semantics and the header's gap-2 wrapper.
work_order.approach:
Fold the critique's better test shape into the proposal. (a) ActivityFeedSkeleton root gets aria-busy="true" and a first child `

Loading activity…

` as GroupPageSkeleton does (sr-only is absolutely positioned, so it adds no gap). It lives in the shared skeleton so failed-feed.test.ts can render it. (b)+(d) Add a pure helper `failedFeedScope(groupsLoaded: boolean, groups: ActivityGroup[], raw)` to lib/activity/queries.ts next to rawGroupScope: when the groups read completed, return the id only if it is one of the viewer's groups (else null); when it did not complete, return rawGroupScope(raw) because nothing can confirm it and dropping it would widen a scoped feed's Retry to every group. ActivityContent tracks a single `let groupsLoaded = false`, set true right after the listActivityGroups await and before the rows read, and the failed branch becomes `` with the comment reworded to 'the raw id is carried only when the groups read could not confirm anything (it did not complete)'. This is a behavioural unit test target instead of another source-text regex, and covers the groups-ok + own-group keep case that the proposal's tests missed. (c) Restore the 8px rhythm with `-mt-4` on the loaded scope `

` (main gap 24px - 16px = 8px; the review's `-mt-3` would leave 12px in this scale) plus `min-h-5` (24px) on that `

`, and give the fallback scope Skeleton `-mt-4 h-5` (24px). Both occupy 24px at the same position, so the 4px arrival shift the proposal accepted is avoided (docs/ui.md: no layout shift when data arrives). The text stays top-aligned in its box; the chips stay 24px below the block. A wrapper div is rejected because it would shrink the line-to-chips distance too; moving the line back into

would need a second groups read outside Suspense. The implementer must confirm Tailwind v4 emits `-mt-4` under the replaced --spacing-* keys by grepping the built CSS and measuring in a browser; if it does not, report back and fall back to accepting 24px and documenting it, not to an invented structure.

The one unverified piece is that Tailwind v4 emits -mt-4 and min-h-5 under the replaced spacing theme, which a build and a measured gap settle; a failure there lowers the outcome to documenting the 24px gap, not to a broken screen.

work_order.debate_summary: The critique's verdict was 'sound' and I agree with the diagnosis; it changed three things. Accepted: the AC-1 and AC-4 skeleton halves cannot be observed in a browser here (environment.md says so), so they are test-verified and the 'throttle the network' QA steps are dropped. Accepted: the 4px arrival shift is avoidable, so the loaded scope line gets min-h-5 to match the 24px skeleton and the 'moves by no more than 4px' clause is gone. Accepted in spirit: the index-order wire test is brittle and a regex on the failed expression is the same flaw that finding 4 reported, so I went further than the critique's two options and extracted a pure failedFeedScope helper with a behavioural test, which also covers the groups-OK + own-group keep case the critique said was missed. The single-flag simplification (drop `failed &&`) is accepted and subsumed by the helper. Dismissed: the aria-busy placement finding (scope-line skeleton outside the busy region) is a note, not a defect, since an empty pulse div is not announced and the proposal's reason about testability stands; the repeated-param and withDb-before-reads edge cases are already handled by existing behaviour and are now unit-cased. Not resolved by debate: -mt-4 is a first in this repo and depends on Tailwind v4 negating the replaced spacing keys; both proposer and critic called it likely but unverified, so the implementer measures it.
